components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface: Send, Allow.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14.536 21.686a.5.5 0 0 0 .937-.024l6.5-19a.496.496 0 0 0-.635-.635l-19 6.5a.5.5 0 0 0-.024.937l7.93 3.18a2 2 0 0 1 1.112 1.11z"/><path d="m21.854 2.147-10.94 10.939"/></svg>Send</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--iv-space-1, 4px); height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--iv-space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--iv-radius-md, 6px); font-family: var(--iv-font-sans, system-ui); font-size: var(--iv-text-md, 13px); font-weight: 500; cursor: default; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--iv-accent, #a9d9a0); color: var(--iv-accent-contrast, #0b2318); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--iv-accent-hover, #bde5b5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The paired alternative: Deny, Interrupt, New session.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--iv-space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid var(--iv-border-strong, rgba(214,235,220,0.15)); border-radius: var(--iv-radius-md, 6px); background: var(--iv-bg-raised, #18211c); color: var(--iv-text, #e4ebe6); font-family: var(--iv-font-sans, system-ui); font-size: var(--iv-text-md, 13px); font-weight: 500; cursor: default; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--iv-bg-hover, rgba(169,217,160,0.06)); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--iv-bg-active, rgba(169,217,160,0.11)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--iv-radius-md, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--iv-text-muted, #9daba2); cursor: default; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--iv-bg-hover, rgba(169,217,160,0.06)); color: var(--iv-text, #e4ebe6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line field; the border takes the focus ring colour.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 240px; height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--iv-space-2, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--iv-border-strong, rgba(214,235,220,0.15)); border-radius: var(--iv-radius-md, 6px); background: var(--iv-bg-raised, #18211c); color: var(--iv-text, #e4ebe6); font-family: var(--iv-font-sans, system-ui); font-size: var(--iv-text-md, 13px); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--iv-text-faint, #788a7e); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline: 2px solid var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: A sidebar row: status mark, truncated title, faint relative time.
components.css: .ds-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 236px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--iv-space-2, 8px); min-height: 30px; padding: 0 var(--iv-space-2, 8px); border: 0; border-radius: var(--iv-radius-md, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--iv-text, #e4ebe6); font-family: var(--iv-font-sans, system-ui); font-size: var(--iv-text-md, 13px); text-align: left; cursor: default; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--iv-bg-hover, rgba(169,217,160,0.06)); } .ds-row-selected { background: var(--iv-bg-active, rgba(169,217,160,0.11)); font-weight: 500; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--iv-focus-ring, #a9d9a0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-meta { color: var(--iv-text-faint, #788a7e); font-size: var(--iv-text-sm, 12px); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dot { flex: none; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-dot-working { background: var(--iv-accent, #a9d9a0); animation: ds-pulse 1600ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } .ds-dot-waiting { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--iv-danger, #f0644a); } .ds-dot-idle { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--iv-text-faint, #788a7e); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 160px; padding: var(--iv-space-1, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--iv-border-strong, rgba(214,235,220,0.15)); border-radius: var(--iv-radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--iv-bg-raised, #18211c); box-shadow: var(--iv-shadow-overlay, 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); font-family: var(--iv-font-sans, system-ui); font-size: var(--iv-text-md, 13px); } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--iv-space-2, 8px); border-radius: var(--iv-radius-sm, 4px); color: var(--iv-text, #e4ebe6); cursor: default; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item-hl { background: var(--iv-bg-active, rgba(169,217,160,0.11)); } .ds-menu-item-danger { color: var(--iv-danger, #f0644a); } .ds-menu-sep { height: 1px; margin: var(--iv-space-1, 4px) 0; background: var(--iv-border, rgba(214,235,220,0.08)); }

narrative.overview:
ivin uses the layout every agent app ships: a project rail, a session sidebar, a transcript, a composer. It is finished to the level of Linear, Zed and Raycast, with fewer facts per row than Linear. The look is calm and flat, built for a window that stays open all day. Neutrals are tinted from the app icon's forest greens. Yew green is the one accent. The icon's red cursor appears only when the user is needed or something failed.

All colours, sizes, radii and durations are `--iv-` CSS custom properties in `packages/ui/src/core/theme/tokens.css`. A theme changes the app by overriding those variables. The built-in theme is "forest", in a dark and a light variant, and follows the system appearance unless `data-theme` forces one. Plugins get the same components as the built-in screens, only through `@ivin/plugin-api`. The reasons are in `docs/adr/0002-design-system-on-base-ui-and-css-custom-properties.md`.

The design does without dense dashboards, IDE chrome, chat bubbles and decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, tinted neutrals. Depth comes from three ground tones and 1px hairlines.
One green accent and one red signal, each with a single job.
System UI type at 13px body, with mono for code, commands and paths.
Shadows only on overlays: menus, tooltips and dialogs.
Every value is a `--iv-` token a theme file can override.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Yew green marks focus, selection, the primary action and "working". It never decorates.

rules.name: The Red Means You Rule
rules.body: Cursor red marks only what needs the user (waiting, an approval) or what went wrong (error, failure). A status colour goes through `--iv-status-working`, `--iv-status-waiting`, `--iv-status-idle` or `--iv-status-failed`, never a raw colour.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: No colour, font or size outside the `--iv-` tokens. Derived tints use `color-mix()` on a token (accent blocks at 8% fill and 40% border, the project mark at 14% fill and 45% border).

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Body copy is 13px system UI. Hierarchy comes from weight and muted tones, not size jumps. 20px is the largest size and appears only inside Markdown.

rules.name: The Overlays-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats above the window". Blocks, the composer, rows and buttons never cast one.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and duration from a `--iv-` token, so a theme file can override it.
Do keep yew green for focus, selection, the primary action and "working", and use at most one primary button per surface.
Do keep cursor red for "waiting for you", approvals, errors and failures, through the `--iv-status-*` tokens.
Do build plugin UI only from `@ivin/plugin-api` components, with layout through `Stack` and `Block`.
Do use mono for code, commands and file paths, and tabular figures for times, counts and costs.
Do keep transcript rows flat and cheap: a block, text, a disclosure, a code block.
donts: Don't put a shadow on anything that does not float above the window.
Don't use chat bubbles, dense dashboards, IDE chrome or decoration.
Don't add inline styles to screens or plugins, or import a UI library into a plugin.
Don't add a font size, weight or radius outside the scales above.
Don't use red for emphasis or decoration.
